The lifespan supervisor keeps live missions scanning with zero viewers, and confirmation policy is explicit in health metadata with single-acquisition versus distinct-acquisition tests.

issue_group_broadcast_receipts_and_missi.note: August 3 persistence contract: broadcast messages use independent ground/satellite receipts; candidate anomaly streaks are keyed by mission and cell; alerts and replay/export rows retain mission_id, use_case_id, and target_pack_id. SQLite connections use WAL/busy timeouts, mutable defaults resolve through core/paths.py, and expensive local work now has process-wide concurrency/time budgets exposed by health metadata.

issue_group_dynamic_use_case_prompt_and_.note: August 3 modularity contract: SAT triage prompts derive target category, task, expected signals, and temporal methods from the active use-case catalog; generic dataset export labels no longer default to deforestation; generated timelapse cache identity includes effective months, bbox, and provider preference while legacy seeded replay keys stay explicit.

issue_group_image_limits_and_local_contr.note: August 3 safety contract: image review and optional depth inference share bounded base64/decoded-byte limits and pixel validation; controlled provenance fields cannot be overwritten by caller metadata; mutating and resource-heavy POST routes require loopback/test-local requests; timelapse, image review, VLM, depth, and analysis calls now have process-wide concurrency and timeout budgets with structured 429/503 responses.

feature_group_hosted_browser_portfolio.note: August 3 hosted presentation: the full app remains at / in the normal build while the hosted build renders the HAIO-inspired terrain shader at / and the normal build keeps /hosted as a local alias. The presentation uses Wllama browser WASM, the sealed public GGUF manifest, validated saved demo packages, local tutoring, reviewed Atacama/Greenland media, and no backend/API/provider controls. Package metadata now loads from a versioned static JSON manifest and local chat keeps bounded same-package history. The current browser runtime is text reasoning over saved evidence, not image-conditioned VLM inference. Both the dev route and production preview are covered by no-backend Playwright smoke tests, including static JSON assets and JavaScript MIME checks.

issue_group_runtime_persistence_and_repl.note: August 3 runtime integrity: scan engines use a mission-scoped lease, loopback HTTP/WebSocket boundaries reject non-local control access, nested request shapes are bounded, replay snapshots validate before reset with compensating restore, generated timelapse/observation/metrics artifacts are runtime-owned with collision-resistant replace-safe writes, and seeded-cache promotion is driven by an explicit temporal use-case contract.
